use_case_name: Publish Air and Surface Surveillance Tracks

claims.content: The goal of the use case is to exchange surveillance information and data usable in providing threat warning information among systems involved in joint operations.

scope_contract.goal_statement: The goal of the use case is to exchange surveillance information and data usable in providing threat warning information among systems involved in joint operations.
scope_contract.canonical_success_scenario: C2 JU publishes a set of air and/or surface surveillance tracks, and each published track's velocity is reported as course and speed.
scope_contract.start_boundary: C2 JU is ready to publish air or surface surveillance track data.
scope_contract.success_boundary: The air/surface surveillance tracks have been published with velocity reported as course and speed.
in_scope_actions: Reporting published track velocity as course and speed
excluded_adjacent_actions: Generating or ingesting tracks before publication
Consuming or delivering published tracks to downstream systems
Archiving or post-processing published track data
